Who we are

A global manufacturing network delivering
precision connectivity solutions.

Founded in 1993 as a cable harness assembly factory, ARNIR grew into design-in and build-to-spec production of connectors, cables, harnesses and electro-mechanical assemblies.

Today the group employs more than 1,000 people across three countries. Each company keeps its own specialty and strengths, under one shared vision of quality, sustainability and customer success.

Services & capabilities

Advanced connectivity solutions for sustained performance.

Design & Engineering

Requirements gathering, material selection, cable architecture and electrical design, tooling and prototyping – through to compliance certification.

01

Connector Manufacturing

15+ years of joint development with Kenpol: high-density round and rectangular, pogo-pin, RF, disposable and harsh-environment connectors.

02

Cable & Harness Assembly

Custom assemblies for aerospace, medical and telecom – high-mix low-volume through mass production, with 300+ IPC-620 certified operators.

03

PCBA

Hybrid tin-lead and lead-free processes, wave and selective soldering, double-sided reflow, conformal coating, SPI / AOI / X-Ray inspection.

04

System Assembly

Fully assembled systems and products – resource management and planning for complex projects that deliver on time, every time.

05
Design & Engineering01 / 05

Our own lab

In-house validation ensures performance.

Design and engineering solutions – from initial prototypes to full-scale manufacturing. Our private test lab runs alongside every design, so each cable, connector and harness reaches production already proven.
